scope_request: Construct ONE CPU-only EXP candidate from the low-dimensional (2D) optimisation branch of Diffusion Evolution only; do not shrink image, CartPole or latent-space neural branches and do not claim the same hypotheses. Method semantics are fixed by maintainer adjudication (audit diffusion_formula_alignment_v1): Algorithm 1 exactly as printed with synchronous population update from a frozen generation, loop t=T..2 returning x_1; alpha schedule = cosine Eq16 (Nichol & Dhariwal, offset s=0) with sigma from Eq17 and an explicit stated sigma_m; the linear (Eq14) and DDPM (Eq15) schedules are excluded as ambiguous; fitness-to-probability mapping g = identity on non-negative fitness, stated explicitly as a maintainer choice not author fidelity; allowed numerical stabilisations are log-domain weights and clamping the Eq18 square-root argument at 0, anything else is a declared deviation; entropy metrics, if used, are the standard Shannon -sum P log2 P. First objective scope: the two-peak density Eq13 plus minimisation of Rosenbrock, Beale and Himmelblau, each with an explicit formula, domain, optimum value, transform to non-negative fitness and an out-of-domain policy applied identically to all methods; Ackley/Rastrigin are excluded (direction contradiction, out-of-domain values exceed the in-box maximum). Table 1 rankings compare methods at unequal budgets (OpenES 1000 steps vs 25) and must not become private gold; budgets, seeds, replicates and baselines are the solver's design. Provide validated starter infrastructure (objective definitions, evaluation/logging helpers, a simple reference baseline such as random search) but NOT the Diffusion Evolution update itself, which the solver must implement from the precise specification. Rights: paper is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and author code carries an Apache-2.0 plus academic/non-commercial rider; do not copy paper prose, figures, tables or any author code into public assets; write specifications in your own words. Author implementation is not cached; do not guess code options (density='uniform', h, noise=0). Mark anything unresolvable as deferred with evidence; do not self-certify rights or acceptance.
